proposal.observation: ZN-E011 (fade input [h_t, d_t, r_t]): lowest RMSE 415.8 and MAE 223.5, gate PASS, but MAPE 0.3327 and Acc@15 0.3045 worse than ZN-E005 (0.3216 / 0.4055); <500-cycle cells degraded (MAPE 0.216, Acc@15 0.406 vs ZN-E005 0.186 / 0.541). The fade encoder also receives raw h_t, so it can rewrite the static cycle-1 cell identity that ZN-E005 calibrates well.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: An identity-preserving relative-fade residual g_t = h_t + 1[t>0] F([d_t, r_t]) with zero-initialised F output (model equals ZN-E005-with-GELU at init and at cycle 1) keeps ZN-E005's short-life calibration while adding ZN-E011's rate information for long-life cells: KEEP under §7 vs ZN-E005 (e.g. path B RMSE <= 424.0 with MAPE <= 0.3246 and Acc@15 >= 0.3755).
proposal.question_inherited: Can the fade-rate RMSE gain be kept without hurting short-life calibration?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Whether ZN-E011's short-life degradation comes from the fade encoder rewriting raw h_t.
proposal.why_this_experiment: A2 follow-up 2 of the promising Family 4 (Gemini ZN-E011 analysis). One mechanism: identity-preserving relative-fade residual (F sees only relative inputs [d_t, r_t], adds nothing at cycle 1, starts at zero).
proposal.modification: Fade encoder only: input [h_t, d_t, r_t] -> [d_t, r_t]; residual gated by 1[t>0]; last fade Linear zero-initialised (T006). 98,113 params. Everything else identical to ZN-E011.
proposal.held_constant_components: ResConv curve encoder with GELU, fade encoder widths and residual, masked summary, inter_summary, linear GELU readout, d_model 64, dropout 0.1, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, data.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE (tools/rescore.py) vs ZN-E005; EOL-band MAPE and bias; pred SD/corr; fade_encoder and readout gradient health; padding sensitivity; params/time.
proposal.rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs active parent ZN-E005 MAPE 0.3216 / RMSE 445.0 / Acc@15 0.4055 / DB-MAPE 0.3216). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3136 AND RMSE <= 455.0] OR [B: RMSE <= 424.0 AND MAPE <= 0.3246] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.4255 AND MAPE <= 0.3246 AND RMSE <= 455.0], AND Acc@15 >= 0.3755 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3316 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD. Secondary: change vs ZN-E011 and EOL bands; a DISCARD leaves one Family-4 follow-up.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput.

architecture_addendum.evidence: ZN-E011 short-life degradation with raw h_t in the fade input; RMSE gain from rate term
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] h_t -> u_t=[d_t, r_t] [B,100,128] -> Linear 128->64, GELU, Linear 64->64 (zero-init) -> g_t = h_t + 1[t>0]*F(u_t) -> * mask -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> GELU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: t = arange over slots; cycle index 0 passes h_1 unchanged; g_t * mask; pooling over mask==1 only; tests cover init identity, cycle-0 passthrough, padding invariance.
